description: Report (or merge in) counters and/or pct/msg on a run, by id. Each named counter (items_processed, items_total, bytes_out, custom.<k>) is monotonic on its own -- a lower value than what's already stored fails validation with nothing written. Read back via host.runs.get/wait/list's counters field.

counters.description: items_processed?, items_total?, bytes_out?, custom?: {k: number} -- each key monotonic.

run_id.description: The run id to report progress on.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.progress
